services.name: Private Tours
services.desc: Please submit your request for a Private Tour. Whether its private food tours or private cocktail tours we have it ready for you. Our South Beach Food Tours and Little Havana Food Tours are a great way to experience the Miami neighborhoods in an intimate atmosphere and with topics catered to your interests. Submit your request and we will do our best job, so you can experience Miami the way only the locals know it. Our guides are living in the neighborhoods where we conduct our Miami activities and will introduce you to stories of the past and present, with everything that makes our neighborhoods unique and world

includes: Full size lunch/dinner divided in 5 local food tasting spots
Guided walking tour with local guide
blurb: Guests join guided walking tours to explore local family-owned eateries in South Beach and Little Havana. Tours include tasting full-size meals at multiple local food spots. The tours last about 3 hours and cover about a mile of walking.
extraNote: Tours follow CDC social distancing policies and mostly outdoors · Gratuities accepted, common rate 15-20% of ticket price
